_note: DECISION: instrument-scope-option-a (see decisions.json). Machine-readable instrument dispositions — the executable form of the reproduction rule (CLAUDE.md; Option A, 2026-08-23). Seeded from the decision table in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-instrument-reproduction-audit.md. Enforced hard at build time by check-static-site.mjs §11 via instrument-rights-gate.mjs. Discipline: a status here is a governance decision — change it only with the decisionRef that recorded the change, never by agent inference. Signatures detect the reproduction that shipped, never plain bedside language ('thoughts of killing yourself' is legitimate clinical phrasing in mse.html and the SP pack and must never become a signature); scan scope is learner-rendered HTML only (matcher vocabulary in *.pack.json is not reproduction); waivers and provisional standings are file-scoped. This file is a build input and must never itself be shipped to either site. officialSource (added 2026-09-03) records where the learner gets the real instrument, so that a withdrawal leaves a route and not a dead end; the schema requires one on every retired/restricted entry, and pages pinned requireOfficialSourceLink must ship it. This library LINKS and never mirrors — hosting a whole form is broader redistribution than the excerpts that were withdrawn, so formUrl is constrained to an absolute https custodian URL and a repo-relative path is a rights change, not an edit. A recorded route is a wayfinding fact, never a permission finding: routes are refreshed freely, statuses only with a decisionRef.

instruments.decisionRef: DECISION: cows-anchors-retired — docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-instrument-reproduction-audit.md — WP-02d (2026-08-23) flagged, not reverted, pending the author's call. RETIRED 2026-09-10 by Joshua Moss, MD (clinical author-of-record), closing the interim waiver. Two reasons, recorded via research return rq-10-2026-09-10 (research_returns.json): (a) the scope analysis is unchanged and now independently re-run — 'this version may be copied and used clinically' licenses clinical copying, and a public teaching site is not the act of treating a patient; (b) the waiver's stated exit condition, a Taylor & Francis scope letter, is not established to be capable of clearing the instrument, since T&F administers the article and is not shown to control the scale wording (finding f2, needs-primary). A waiver whose exit condition may never fire is a permanent waiver by accident. Withdrawal follows the ciwa-ar pattern on the same page: item names and legal score values are facts and stay; the 45 published anchor strings are replaced with abbreviated descriptors written in-house. A permission request to T&F goes out in parallel; if it returns a license this entry moves to cleared and the published anchors may return as permission rather than as a self-granted waiver.

instruments.decisionRef: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-instrument-reproduction-audit.md — Option A resolution (2026-08-23): provisionally stay — Pfizer's standard form footer states no permission is required, but this must be verified against the current form before it is relied on (WP-02c, open) || 2026-09-10, boundary recorded (research return rq-10-2026-09-10, finding f5; status UNCHANGED pending a decision record): the custodian permission names four verbs — reproduce, translate, display, distribute — and does not name modify, adapt or derivative works, while Pfizer's generic site terms restrict derivative works. A faithful verbatim render is inside the permission; changing wording, response options, ordering, time frame or instructions is not. WP-02c's verification is complete: docs/permissions/phqscreeners-2026-09-10.md captures the live sentence read 2026-09-10.

officialSource.note: EVIDENCE FOR WP-02c, NOT A RESOLUTION OF IT. Secondary sources consistently report that Pfizer released the PHQ family and GAD-7 with no copyright restriction on 2010-07-21 and that the current form footer reads 'No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute'. That is what WP-02c asks about, but it is second-hand — the same shape of evidence that failed for CIWA-Ar, where every 'may be reproduced freely' notice turned out to be a reproducer's addition. Status stays 'provisional' until the author reads the footer on the current form at this URL. redistribution is recorded 'link-only' because that is this library's policy, not because the grant is doubted.
